name: header-transparent
title: Transparent header
author: Lambda Curry <https://github.com/lambda-curry>
description: A header that overlays the opening image in light or dark ink, with a native popover menu on narrow screens and, where supported, a solid surface that fades in while scrolling.

meta.useWhen: The page opens with a full-bleed photograph or artwork that should start at the very top.
meta.avoidWhen: The opening is text on a plain background, or the image is busy where the header sits. Use header-minimal or header-floating.

docs: Import from src/components/blocks/HeaderTransparent.astro and put a full-bleed opening such as hero-immersive directly after it.
